title: VeloraOS 1.10.43 - Memory UI & Chat Draft Hotfix
releaseNotes: Fixes Global Memory controls failing with Velora.addMemory is not a function.
Exports all Global Memory actions to the VeloraOS UI event layer.
Preserves unsent chat drafts per conversation across UI re-renders.
Preserves composer focus and cursor position across necessary Chat refreshes.
Includes the complete 1.10.43 installer and updater payload rather than a compact frontend-only patch.
Preserves Runtime Context, Global Memory, Web Intelligence, licensing, TLS identity, installed Ollama models and existing user data.
